self_reflection_notes: Adjusted atom_index 4 score from 0.0 to 0.5. Initial assessment penalized the horse color attribute entirely because it failed the 'sorrel' taxonomy checkpoint (which requires chestnut/brown), even though it correctly matched the user prompt ('black horses'). Per Checklist Item 1 (Score-Reasoning Consistency) and Item 5 (Harshness Bias), a complete failure was too harsh given the prompt was followed correctly. The revised score of 0.5 reflects the average of perfect QA alignment (1.0) and failed taxonomy alignment (0.0). All other scores remain unchanged as they were consistent with expert evidence and visual verification. No leniency bias detected; Router's verdicts were independently verified against the image and expert testimonies.
